1. Heard Sri Abhishek Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri Manish Kumar Pandey,
learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.
2.

By means of the instant application the applicant Amit Kumar Gautam S/o Ram Dheeraj seeks bail in Case Crime No. 249 of 2022, under sections 363, 366, 376, I.P.C., and sections 5, 6,
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, P.S. Haidergarh, District Barabanki.

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a First Information Report (F.I.R.) lodged on 01.07.2022 implicating two persons on the basis of suspicion, not including the applicant, stating that the informant's daughter had gone missing in the evening of 10.06.2022.
4.
In her statement recorded under section 161, Cr.P.C. the victim has stated that she is aged about 19 years and she had gone with the applicant out of her own free-will and she has married him.

sentences.text: The victim declined her internal and external medico-legal examination and in her radiological examination her age has been opined to be around 21 years.
6. In her statement recorded under section 164, Cr.P.C. also the victim has stated that she has married the applicant and she would not return to her parents.
7. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail-application, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that the victim is major as per her own claim and as per her radiological examination report; that she has consistently stated that she has married with the applicant out of her own freewill, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
